{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794721367734,"sessionID":"ses_e2247747bffeK82TWTGuBjTUDR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"brEqA5qLyZGl3tpX","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/opt_day1.py","content":"import json\n\n# Dept sizes and Day 1 normal doc counts:\n# Legal: 4 (3 docs)\n# Research: 8 (2 docs)\n# Eng: 9 (1 doc)\n# Finance: 8 (1 doc)\n# Sales: 11 (1 doc)\ndocs_held = [3]*4 + [2]*8 + [1]*28  # 40 employees sorted by normal docs held descending\n\nfor k1 in range(6, 21):\n    for k2 in range(6, 21):\n        if k1 + k2 > 40:\n            continue\n        # Give canaries first to employees with fewest normal docs!\n        # Assign last k1+k2 employees\n        p_canary_leak = 0.0\n        for idx in range(40):\n            m = docs_held[idx]\n            # check if in c1 or c2 (disjoint)\n            # put lowest-m employees in c1 and c2\n            rev_idx = 39 - idx\n            if rev_idx < k1:\n                w = 1.0 - k1 / 40.0\n                p_canary_leak += (1/40) * 0.65 * (w / (m + w))\n            elif rev_idx < k1 + k2:\n                w = 1.0 - k2 / 40.0\n                p_canary_leak += (1/40) * 0.65 * (w / (m + w))\n        if abs(k1 - k2) <= 1:\n            print(f\"k1={k1}, k2={k2}, total={k1+k2}: P(Day1 canary leak) = {p_canary_leak:.4f}\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/opt_day1.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/opt_day1.py","time":{"start":1794721367726,"end":1794721367733}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1ddbac6a80014YD1JW7HNIdzGq","sessionID":"ses_e2247747bffeK82TWTGuBjTUDR","messageID":"msg_1ddb9abae001gF0f4xJKpj2UvS"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794721474749,"sessionID":"ses_e2247747bffeK82TWTGuBjTUDR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"HrV9uW330BnyPBkk","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/sim_strategies.py","content":"import random\nfrom collections import Counter\n\n# Quick Monte Carlo of Hard tier information + V cost\n# Compare:\n# S0: Wait until first leak surfaces (Day 3 or 4), then plant canaries on suspect set\n# S1: Plant 1 canary on Day 1 (size 18 on 1-doc employees), then wait for Day 3/4\n# S2: Plant 2 canaries on Day 1 (size 18+18), then wait for Day 3/4\n\nrandom.seed(42)\n\n# Dept structure matching our exact game:\ndepts = {\n    \"Legal\": 4,\n    \"Research\": 8,\n    \"Finance\": 8,\n    \"Engineering\": 9,\n    \"Sales\": 11,\n}\nemp_dept = []\nfor d, cnt in depts.items():\n    emp_dept.extend([d]*cnt)\ndept_names = list(depts.keys())\n\ndef sim_episode(plant_d1=0):\n    mole = random.randrange(40)\n    decoy = random.choice([i for i in range(40) if i != mole])\n    \n    # Track log likelihoods for each employee\n    # Start after decoy eliminated on Day 2\n    V = 1.0\n    docs = [] # (day, recipients_set, is_canary, variants_dict)\n    \n    # Day 1 exact docs:\n    # d1-1: Legal+Research (12), d1-2: Legal+Eng (13), d1-3: Legal+Research (12), d1-4: Fin+Sales (19)\n    def get_emps(ds):\n        return {i for i, d in enumerate(emp_dept) if d in ds}\n    docs.append((1, get_emps([\"Legal\", \"Research\"]), False, None))\n    docs.append((1, get_emps([\"Legal\", \"Engineering\"]), False, None))\n    docs.append((1, get_emps([\"Legal\", \"Research\"]), False, None))\n    docs.append((1, get_emps([\"Finance\", \"Sales\"]), False, None))\n    \n    if plant_d1 >= 1:\n        # pick 18 1-doc employees\n        one_doc = [i for i, d in enumerate(emp_dept) if d in (\"Engineering\", \"Finance\", \"Sales\")]\n        random.shuffle(one_doc)\n        c1_emps = one_doc[:18]\n        vmap = {e: c1_emps.index(e) % 3 for e in c1_emps}\n        docs.append((1, set(c1_emps), True, vmap))\n        V -= 0.01\n        if plant_d1 >= 2:\n            rem = [i for i in range(40) if i not in c1_emps and emp_dept[i] != \"Legal\"]\n            vmap2 = {e: idx % 3 for idx, e in enumerate(rem[:18])}\n            docs.append((1, set(vmap2.keys()), True, vmap2))\n            V -= 0.01\n\n    leaked_doc_ids = set()\n    pending_leaks = [] # (surface_day, doc_idx, shown_variant)\n    \n    # Posteriors (unnormalized log probs)\n    import math\n    logp = [0.0]*40\n    logp[decoy] = -1e9\n    \n    for day in range(1, 22):\n        if day > 1:\n            n_new = random.choice([2, 3, 4])\n            for _ in range(n_new):\n                d2 = random.sample(dept_names, 2)\n                docs.append((day, get_emps(d2), False, None))\n        \n        # Surface leaks\n        for sday, didx, svar in pending_leaks:\n            if sday == day:\n                _, recips, is_c, vmap = docs[didx]\n                for e in range(40):\n                    if e not in recips:\n                        logp[e] = -1e9\n                    elif is_c:\n                        if vmap[e] == svar:\n                            logp[e] += math.log(0.95)\n                        else:\n                            n_other = len(set(vmap.values())) - 1\n                            logp[e] += math.log(0.05 / max(1, n_other))\n        \n        # Access logs from day-1 (if day > 1):\n        # Assume conservative 1.0 access per employee per day\n        if day > 1:\n            for e in range(40):\n                n_acc = 1 # approx Poisson(1)\n                p_ah = 0.3 if e == mole else 0.1\n                ah = sum(1 for _ in range(n_acc) if random.random() < p_ah)\n                # plus framing for non-mole non-decoy: avg 1/38 per day\n                if e != mole and e != decoy and random.random() < (1.0/38.0):\n                    ah += 1\n                # update logp\n                # P(ah | mole) vs P(ah | innocent): rough LR 2.5 per ah, 0.8 per non-ah\n                if ah > 0:\n                    logp[e] += ah * math.log(0.30 / 0.126)\n                else:\n                    logp[e] += math.log(0.70 / 0.874)\n            # 6 free interviews on top suspects!\n            alive = sorted([e for e in range(40) if logp[e] > -1e8], key=lambda x: -logp[x])\n            for e in alive[:6]:\n                evasive = random.random() < (0.24 if e == mole else 0.20)\n                logp[e] += math.log(1.2 if evasive else (0.76/0.80))\n\n        # Check posterior max\n        mx = max(logp)\n        probs = [math.exp(lp - mx) if lp > -1e8 else 0.0 for lp in logp]\n        s = sum(probs)\n        probs = [p/s for p in probs]\n        best_p = max(probs)\n        best_e = probs.index(best_p)\n        \n        if best_p >= 0.985 or (day == 21 and best_p * V - (1 - best_p) > 0):\n            return V if best_e == mole else -1.0, day, best_p\n        \n        # Decide whether to plant targeted canaries today (for day >= 3 when suspects narrowed)\n        sig_suspects = [e for e in range(40) if probs[e] >= 0.005]\n        if day >= 3 and 2 <= len(sig_suspects) <= 18:\n            # Plant 1 or 2 targeted canaries on sig_suspects (if len >= 4 to avoid <=3 rule, pad to 4 if needed)\n            pool = list(sig_suspects)\n            while len(pool) < 4:\n                extra = random.choice([e for e in range(40) if e not in pool and e != decoy])\n                pool.append(extra)\n            # Canary 1\n            vmap1 = {e: idx % 3 for idx, e in enumerate(pool)}\n            docs.append((day, set(pool), True, vmap1))\n            V -= 0.01\n            if len(sig_suspects) >= 4:\n                # Orthogonal Canary 2!\n                vmap2 = {e: (idx // 3) % 3 for idx, e in enumerate(pool)}\n                if len(set(vmap2.values())) >= 2:\n                    docs.append((day, set(pool), True, vmap2))\n                    V -= 0.01\n\n        # End of day: mole leaks\n        elig = [idx for idx, (d, recips, _, _) in enumerate(docs)\n                if day - 2 <= d <= day and mole in recips and idx not in leaked_doc_ids]\n        if elig and random.random() < 0.65:\n            weights = []\n            for idx in elig:\n                _, recips, is_c, _ = docs[idx]\n                w = (1.0 - len(recips)/40.0) if is_c else 1.0\n                weights.append(w)\n            chosen = random.choices(elig, weights=weights, k=1)[0]\n            leaked_doc_ids.add(chosen)\n            V = max(0.0, V - 0.05)\n            delay = random.choice([2, 3])\n            _, _, is_c, vmap = docs[chosen]\n            svar = None\n            if is_c:\n                true_v = vmap[mole]\n                if random.random() < 0.95 or len(set(vmap.values())) == 1:\n                    svar = true_v\n                else:\n                    others = [v for v in set(vmap.values()) if v != true_v]\n                    svar = random.choice(others)\n            pending_leaks.append((day + delay, chosen, svar))\n\n    return 0.0, 21, 0.0\n\nfor pd1 in [0, 1, 2]:\n    res = [sim_episode(pd1) for _ in range(3000)]\n    avg_score = sum(r[0] for r in res) / len(res)\n    avg_day = sum(r[1] for r in res) / len(res)\n    wrongs = sum(1 for r in res if r[0] < 0)\n    print(f\"plant_d1={pd1}: avg_score={avg_score:.4f}, avg_day={avg_day:.2f}, wrongs={wrongs}/3000\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/sim_strategies.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/sim_strategies.py","time":{"start":1794721474740,"end":1794721474747}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1ddbc68aa00158HqDanVeDeZjW","sessionID":"ses_e2247747bffeK82TWTGuBjTUDR","messageID":"msg_1ddbb7b0f001b0Rdfvh47TjQh6"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794721840091,"sessionID":"ses_e2247747bffeK82TWTGuBjTUDR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"eqyEKceCn27bQXWU","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import json, random\n\nfrom make_d1 import employees, c1 as d1_c1, c2 as d1_c2\n\nemp_map = {e[\"id\"]: e for e in employees}\nd1_bucket = {}\nfor e, v in d1_c1.items():\n    d1_bucket[e] = \"c1:\" + v\nfor e, v in d1_c2.items():\n    d1_bucket[e] = \"c2:\" + v\n\nsuspects = [e[\"id\"] for e in employees if e[\"id\"] != \"e27\"]\nassert len(suspects) == 39\n\n# Target bucket sizes for Day 2: [7, 7, 6, 7, 6, 6] -> c2_1 has 20, c2_2 has 19\ntarget_sizes = [7, 7, 6, 7, 6, 6]\nslots = []\nfor b, sz in enumerate(target_sizes):\n    slots.extend([b]*sz)\n\nrandom.seed(123)\nbest_assign = None\nbest_cost = 1e9\n\n# Simulated annealing / random swap search\ncur = list(slots)\nrandom.shuffle(cur)\n\ndef cost(arr):\n    # arr[i] is bucket (0..5) for suspects[i]\n    d1_d2 = {}\n    d2_dept = {}\n    pen = 0\n    for i, b2 in enumerate(arr):\n        eid = suspects[i]\n        b1 = d1_bucket[eid]\n        dept = emp_map[eid][\"dept\"]\n        cl = emp_map[eid][\"clearance\"]\n        k1 = (b1, b2)\n        d1_d2.setdefault(k1, []).append((dept, cl))\n        k2 = (b2, dept)\n        d2_dept.setdefault(k2, []).append(cl)\n    for k1, lst in d1_d2.items():\n        if len(lst) > 2:\n            pen += 1000 * (len(lst) - 2)\n        elif len(lst) == 2:\n            pen += 10 # inevitable 3 times\n            if lst[0][0] == lst[1][0]: # same dept!\n                pen += 500\n    for k2, lst in d2_dept.items():\n        if len(lst) > 2:\n            pen += 1000 * (len(lst) - 2)\n        elif len(lst) == 2:\n            if lst[0] == lst[1]: # same clearance in same dept & bucket\n                pen += 5\n    return pen\n\ncur_c = cost(cur)\nfor step in range(50000):\n    i, j = random.sample(range(39), 2)\n    if cur[i] == cur[j]:\n        continue\n    cur[i], cur[j] = cur[j], cur[i]\n    nc = cost(cur)\n    if nc <= cur_c:\n        cur_c = nc\n        if cur_c == 30: # 3 pairs * 10 + 0 clearance collisions!\n            break\n    else:\n        cur[i], cur[j] = cur[j], cur[i]\n\nprint(\"Final cost:\", cur_c)\nlabels = [\"A\", \"B\", \"C\"]\nd2_c1, d2_c2 = {}, {}\nfor i, b2 in enumerate(cur):\n    eid = suspects[i]\n    if b2 < 3:\n        d2_c1[eid] = labels[b2]\n    else:\n        d2_c2[eid] = labels[b2 - 3]\n\n# Verify properties\nfrom collections import Counter\nd1d2_cnt = Counter((d1_bucket[e], b2) for e, b2 in zip(suspects, cur))\nprint(\"Max (d1,d2) cell size:\", max(d1d2_cnt.values()), \"Count of size 2:\", sum(1 for v in d1d2_cnt.values() if v==2))\nd2dept_cnt = Counter((b2, emp_map[e][\"dept\"]) for e, b2 in zip(suspects, cur))\nprint(\"Max (d2,dept) cell size:\", max(d2dept_cnt.values()))\nprint(\"d2_c1 (len={}):\".format(len(d2_c1)), json.dumps(dict(sorted(d2_c1.items()))))\nprint(\"d2_c2 (len={}):\".format(len(d2_c2)), json.dumps(dict(sorted(d2_c2.items()))))\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/make_d2.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/make_d2.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/make_d2.py","time":{"start":1794721840080,"end":1794721840089}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1ddc1fbbd001h4jaFx3kt0Scdk","sessionID":"ses_e2247747bffeK82TWTGuBjTUDR","messageID":"msg_1ddc1253b001HSeKV14Ado6aZQ"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794722055097,"sessionID":"ses_e2247747bffeK82TWTGuBjTUDR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"vCGQB7ofqNIjpwUg","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import json, math\n\n# Exact candidate set after d1-3 and c2-2 leaks:\n# All other 34 employees have ZERO probability (did not receive both d1-3 and c2-2).\ncands = {\n    \"e16\": {\"dept\": \"Research\", \"cl\": 3, \"c2_2\": \"A\"},\n    \"e30\": {\"dept\": \"Research\", \"cl\": 2, \"c2_2\": \"A\"},\n    \"e04\": {\"dept\": \"Research\", \"cl\": 3, \"c2_2\": \"B\"},\n    \"e24\": {\"dept\": \"Legal\",    \"cl\": 3, \"c2_2\": \"B\"},\n    \"e03\": {\"dept\": \"Legal\",    \"cl\": 3, \"c2_2\": \"C\"},\n    \"e34\": {\"dept\": \"Research\", \"cl\": 2, \"c2_2\": \"C\"},\n}\n\n# Access logs Days 1-3 for these 6 candidates:\n# Let's record (normal_hours, after_hours) per day for all 6:\nlogs_d1 = [\n    (\"e03\", False), (\"e16\", False), (\"e16\", True), (\"e30\", False), (\"e34\", False)\n]\nlogs_d2 = [\n    (\"e03\", True), (\"e03\", True), (\"e04\", False), (\"e04\", False), (\"e34\", False)\n]\nlogs_d3 = [\n    (\"e03\", False), (\"e04\", False), (\"e16\", False), (\"e24\", False), (\"e30\", False)\n]\n\nah_counts = {e: 0 for e in cands}\nnh_counts = {e: 0 for e in cands}\nfor day_logs in [logs_d1, logs_d2, logs_d3]:\n    for e, ah in day_logs:\n        if e in cands:\n            if ah: ah_counts[e] += 1\n            else: nh_counts[e] += 1\n\n# Interviews conducted so far on these 6:\n# Day 2: e16 (recent_documents) -> non-evasive\n# Day 3: e03 (recent_documents) -> non-evasive\ninterviews = [\n    (\"e16\", False),\n    (\"e03\", False),\n]\n\n# Compute log posterior under exact generative model:\n# For 3 closed days:\n# Mole: normal_hours ~ Poisson(3 * 0.7), after_hours ~ Poisson(3 * 0.3) [mole is never framed]\n# Innocent (non-decoy): normal_hours ~ Poisson(3 * 0.9), after_hours ~ Poisson(3 * (0.1 + f_rate))\n# where f_rate = 2.0 * 0.5 / 38 = 1/38 per day (or + 1/39 if DSL frames random colleague; let's check both!)\n\nfor dsl_frame in [0.0, 1.0/39.0]:\n    logp = {}\n    for m in cands:\n        lp = 0.0\n        # Canary c2-2 variant A\n        lp += math.log(0.95 if cands[m][\"c2_2\"] == \"A\" else 0.025)\n        # Access logs across all 6 (note innocent likelihood cancels across common factors except for m!)\n        # Log LR for m being mole vs innocent:\n        # normal_hours[m]: k * log(0.7 / 0.9) - 3 * (0.7 - 0.9)\n        inno_ah_rate = 0.1 + (1.0/38.0) + dsl_frame\n        lp += nh_counts[m] * math.log(0.7 / 0.9) - 3.0 * (0.7 - 0.9)\n        lp += ah_counts[m] * math.log(0.3 / inno_ah_rate) - 3.0 * (0.3 - inno_ah_rate)\n        # Interviews:\n        for ie, ev in interviews:\n            if ie == m:\n                lp += math.log(1.2 if ev else (0.76 / 0.80))\n        logp[m] = lp\n    mx = max(logp.values())\n    ps = {m: math.exp(v - mx) for m, v in logp.items()}\n    s = sum(ps.values())\n    ps = {m: v/s for m, v in ps.items()}\n    print(f\"=== dsl_frame={dsl_frame:.4f} ===\")\n    for m, p in sorted(ps.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):\n        print(f\"  {m} ({cands[m]['dept']}, c2-2:{cands[m]['c2_2']}, nh={nh_counts[m]}, ah={ah_counts[m]}): P = {p:.4f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py"},"output":"Wrote file Let's include Day 3 night leak in sim!\n# On Day 3:\n# Research cands (e16, e30, e34, e04) held:\n#   d1-1 (day 1), c1 or c1-2 (day 1), d2-3 (day 2), d3-3 (day 3) [since d1-3 and c2-2 already leaked!]\n#   Note: e16, e04 had c1; e30, e34 had c1-2!\n# Legal cands (e03, e24) held:\n#   d1-1 (day 1), d1-2 (day 1), c1(e03)/c1-2(e24) (day 1), d2-1 (day 2), d2-2 (day 2), d3-1 (day 3)\n\nc1_set = {\"e16\", \"e04\", \"e03\"}\nc1_2_set = {\"e30\", \"e34\", \"e24\"}\n\ndef sim_from_d4(mode=\"overlap6\", thresh=0.985):\n    mole = random.choices(cands, weights=priors, k=1)[0]\n    V = 0.86 # visible V on Day 4 morning (note if Day 3 leaked, true V is 0.81)\n    true_V = 0.86\n    \n    # Reconstruct docs from Days 1-4 relevant to the 6 candidates:\n    # (doc_id, day, recips_set, is_canary, vmap)\n    docs = [\n        (\"d1-1\", 1, set(cands), False, None),\n        (\"d1-2\", 1, {\"e03\", \"e24\"}, False, None),\n        (\"c1\",   1, {\"e16\", \"e04\", \"e03\"}, True, {\"e16\":\"B\", \"e04\":\"A\", \"e03\":\"A\"}),\n        (\"c1-2\", 1, {\"e30\", \"e34\", \"e24\"}, True, {\"e30\":\"B\", \"e34\":\"C\", \"e24\":\"B\"}),\n        (\"d2-1\", 2, {\"e03\", \"e24\"}, False, None),\n        (\"d2-2\", 2, {\"e03\", \"e24\"}, False, None),\n        (\"d2-3\", 2, {\"e16\", \"e30\", \"e34\", \"e04\"}, False, None),\n        (\"d3-1\", 3, {\"e03\", \"e24\"}, False, None),\n        (\"d3-3\", 3, {\"e16\", \"e30\", \"e34\", \"e04\"}, False, None),\n        (\"d4-1\", 4, {\"e16\", \"e30\", \"e34\", \"e04\"}, False, None),\n        (\"d4-2\", 4, {\"e16\", \"e30\", \"e34\", \"e04\"}, False, None),\n    ]\n    # Note true recipient sizes out of 40 for careful weight:\n    true_sizes = {\"c1\": 20, \"c1-2\": 20}\n    leaked = set()\n    pending = []\n    \n    # Simulate Day 3 night leak (already happened before Day 4!):\n    elig3 = [d for d in docs if 1 <= d[1] <= 3 and mole in d[2]]\n    if random.random() < 0.65:\n        ws = [(1.0 - true_sizes[d[0]]/40.0) if d[3] else 1.0 for d in elig3]\n        ch = random.choices(elig3, weights=ws, k=1)[0]\n        leaked.add(ch[0])\n        true_V -= 0.05\n        sday = 3 + random.choice([2, 3])\n        svar = None\n        if ch[3]:\n            tv = ch[4][mole]\n            svar = tv if random.random() < 0.95 else random.choice([x for x in [\"A\",\"B\",\"C\"] if x != tv])\n        pending.append((sday, ch, svar))\n\n    logp = {e: math.log(p) for e, p in zip(cands, priors)}\n\n    for day in range(4, 22):\n        if day >= 5:\n            # Surface leaks\n            for sday, ch, svar in pending:\n                if sday == day:\n                    _, _, recips, is_c, vmap = ch\n                    for e in cands:\n                        if e not in recips:\n                            logp[e] = -1e9\n                        elif is_c:\n                            logp[e] += math.log(0.95 if vmap[e] == svar else 0.025)\n            # Access logs from day-1 + 6 interviews on alive cands!\n            for e in cands:\n                p_ah = 0.3 if e == mole else 0.126\n                ah = 1 if random.random() < p_ah else 0\n                logp[e] += math.log(0.3/0.126) if ah else math.log(0.7/0.874)\n            alive = sorted([e for e in cands if logp[e] > -1e8], key=lambda x: -logp[x])\n            # 6 interviews across top candidates (multiple topics!)\n            for idx_i in range(6):\n                e = alive[idx_i % len(alive)]\n                ev = random.random() < (0.24 if e == mole else 0.20)\n                logp[e] += math.log(1.2 if ev else 0.95)\n            # New normal docs on day >= 5\n            for k in range(random.choice([2, 3, 4])):\n                d2 = random.sample([\"Legal\", \"Research\", \"Finance\", \"Engineering\", \"Sales\"], 2)\n                rc = {e for e in cands if depts[e] in d2}\n                docs.append((f\"d{day}-{k}\", day, rc, False, None))\n        else:\n            # Day 4: we have 6 actions left (2 for canaries + 4 interviews, or 0 canaries + 6 interviews)\n            n_int = 4 if mode != \"none\" else 6\n            for idx_i in range(n_int):\n                e = cands[idx_i % 2] # focus interviews on e16 and e30!\n                ev = random.random() < (0.24 if e == mole else 0.20)\n                logp[e] += math.log(1.2 if ev else 0.95)\n\n        mx = max(logp.values())\n        ps = {e: (math.exp(v - mx) if v > -1e8 else 0.0) for e, v in logp.items()}\n        s = sum(ps.values())\n        ps = {e: v/s for e, v in ps.items()}\n        best_e = max(ps, key=lambda x: ps[x])\n        best_p = ps[best_e]\n\n        if best_p >= thresh or (day == 21 and best_p * true_V - (1 - best_p) > 0):\n            return (true_V if best_e == mole else -1.0), day, best_e == mole\n\n        # Plant canaries on Day 4 and Day 5 (and later if still needed)\n        alive = [e for e in cands if ps[e] >= 0.005]\n        if mode == \"overlap6\" and len(alive) >= 2 and day <= 8:\n            # Put top 1 in A, top 2 in B, rest in C; pad to >=4 recipients with zero-prob dummies\n            sa = sorted(alive, key=lambda x: -ps[x])\n            v1 = {}\n            v2 = {}\n            for i, e in enumerate(sa):\n                v1[e] = \"A\" if i == 0 else (\"B\" if i == 1 else \"C\")\n                v2[e] = \"A\" if i % 3 == 0 else (\"B\" if i % 3 == 1 else \"C\")\n            sz = max(4, len(sa))\n            if len(set(v1.values())) == 2: v1[\"dummy\"] = \"C\"\n            if len(set(v2.values())) == 2: v2[\"dummy\"] = \"C\"\n            docs.append((f\"c{day}-1\", day, set(sa), True, v1)); true_sizes[f\"c{day}-1\"] = sz; true_V -= 0.01\n            docs.append((f\"c{day}-2\", day, set(sa), True, v2)); true_sizes[f\"c{day}-2\"] = sz; true_V -= 0.01\n        elif mode == \"disjoint4\" and len(alive) >= 2 and day <= 8:\n            sa = sorted(alive, key=lambda x: -ps[x])\n            g1 = [sa[i] for i in range(0, len(sa), 2)]\n            g2 = [sa[i] for i in range(1, len(sa), 2)]\n            v1 = {e: [\"A\",\"B\",\"C\"][i%3] for i, e in enumerate(g1)}; v1[\"d1\"]=\"B\"; v1[\"d2\"]=\"C\"\n            v2 = {e: [\"A\",\"B\",\"C\"][i%3] for i, e in enumerate(g2)}; v2[\"d1\"]=\"B\"; v2[\"d2\"]=\"C\"\n            docs.append((f\"c{day}-1\", day, set(g1), True, v1)); true_sizes[f\"c{day}-1\"] = max(4, len(g1)); true_V -= 0.01\n            docs.append((f\"c{day}-2\", day, set(g2), True, v2)); true_sizes[f\"c{day}-2\"] = max(4, len(g2)); true_V -= 0.01\n\n        # End of day leak\n        elig = [d for d in docs if day-2 <= d[1] <= day and mole in d[2] and d[0] not in leaked]\n        if elig and random.random() < 0.65:\n            ws = [(1.0 - true_sizes[d[0]]/40.0) if d[3] else 1.0 for d in elig]\n            ch = random.choices(elig, weights=ws, k=1)[0]\n            leaked.add(ch[0])\n            true_V = max(0.0, true_V - 0.05)\n            sday = day + random.choice([2, 3])\n            svar = None\n            if ch[3]:\n                tv = ch[4][mole]\n                svar = tv if random.random() < 0.95 else random.choice([x for x in [\"A\",\"B\",\"C\"] if x != tv])\n            pending.append((sday, ch, svar))\n    return 0.0, 21, False\n\nfor mode in [\"none\", \"overlap6\", \"disjoint4\"]:\n    for th in [0.97, 0.985, 0.992]:\n        res = [sim_from_d4(mode, th) for _ in range(5000)]\n        avg_s = sum(r[0] for r in res)/len(res)\n        avg_d = sum(r[1] for r in res)/len(res)\n        acc = sum(1 for r in res if r[2])/len(res)\n        print(f\"mode={mode:10s} th={th:.3f}: E[score]={avg_s:.4f}, E[day]={avg_d:.2f}, acc={acc:.4f}\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/sim_d4.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/sim_d4.py","time":{"start":1794722158439,"end":1794722158448}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1ddc6d760001N67r4nQt28ZOX7","sessionID":"ses_e2247747bffeK82TWTGuBjTUDR","messageID":"msg_1ddc588b1001qEMgh09stSV3c9"}}

It's not like I keep a list.\")\n#        e16 (workload) -> F\n#        e30 (recent_documents) -> F\n#        e30 (contacts_outside) -> F\n# Day 5: e16 (recent_documents) -> F\n#        e16 (contacts_outside) -> F\n#        e16 (access_needs) -> F\n#        e30 (workload) -> F\n#        e30 (access_needs) -> F\nev_t = {\"e16\": 1, \"e30\": 0, \"e34\": 0, \"e04\": 0}\nev_f = {\"e16\": 5, \"e30\": 4, \"e34\": 0, \"e04\": 0}\n\nn_days = 5\nfor use_nh in [True, False]:\n    logp = {}\n    for m in cands:\n        lp = math.log(0.95 if cands[m][\"c2_2\"] == \"A\" else 0.025)\n        inno_ah = 0.1 + 1.0/38.0\n        if use_nh:\n            lp += nh[m] * math.log(0.7 / 0.9) - n_days * (0.7 - 0.9)\n        lp += ah[m] * math.log(0.3 / inno_ah) - n_days * (0.3 - inno_ah)\n        lp += ev_t[m] * math.log(1.2) + ev_f[m] * math.log(0.76 / 0.80)\n        logp[m] = lp\n    mx = max(logp.values())\n    ps = {m: math.exp(v - mx) for m, v in logp.items()}\n    s = sum(ps.values())\n    ps = {m: v/s for m, v in ps.items()}\n    print(f\"=== use_nh={use_nh} ===\")\n    for m, p in sorted(ps.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1]):\n        print(f\"  {m}: P = {p:.4f} (nh={nh[m]}, ah={ah[m]}, ev={ev_t[m]}/{ev_t[m]+ev_f[m]})\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker_d6.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/tracker_d6.py","time":{"start":1794722537551,"end":1794722537556}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1ddcca049001XP5egus5Dc3zLR","sessionID":"ses_e2247747bffeK82TWTGuBjTUDR","messageID":"msg_1ddcb53b5001YuUvuPg3Zn3VwX"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794722654179,"sessionID":"ses_e2247747bffeK82TWTGuBjTUDR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"v61kWqYGcl3upfgW","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker_d7.py","content":"import math\n\ncands = {\n    \"e16\": {\"c2_2\": \"A\"},\n    \"e30\": {\"c2_2\": \"A\"},\n    \"e34\": {\"c2_2\": \"C\"},\n    \"e04\": {\"c2_2\": \"B\"},\n}\n\n# Exact access log counts across Days 1-6 for e16, e30, e34, e04:\n# Day 1-5: nh = {\"e16\": 5, \"e30\": 8, \"e34\": 2, \"e04\": 7}, ah = {\"e16\": 1, \"e30\": 0, \"e34\": 0, \"e04\": 0}\n# Day 6:   e04: 1F; e16: 1T; e30: 3F; e34: 1F\nnh = {\"e16\": 5, \"e30\": 11, \"e34\": 3, \"e04\": 8}\nah = {\"e16\": 2, \"e30\": 0,  \"e34\": 0, \"e04\": 0}\n\n# Exact interviews across Days 1-6:\n# Day 1-5: ev_t = {\"e16\": 1, \"e30\": 0}, ev_f = {\"e16\": 5, \"e30\": 4}\n# Day 6:   e16: 2F; e30: 1T, 1F\nev_t = {\"e16\": 1, \"e30\": 1, \"e34\": 0, \"e04\": 0}\nev_f = {\"e16\": 7, \"e30\": 5, \"e34\": 0, \"e04\": 0}\n\nn_days = 6\nfor use_nh in [True, False]:\n    for dsl_frame in [0.0, 1.0/39.0]:\n        logp = {}\n        for m in cands:\n            lp = math.log(0.95 if cands[m][\"c2_2\"] == \"A\" else 0.025)\n            inno_ah = 0.1 + 1.0/38.0 + dsl_frame\n            if use_nh:\n                lp += nh[m] * math.log(0.7 / 0.9) - n_days * (0.7 - 0.9)\n            lp += ah[m] * math.log(0.3 / inno_ah) - n_days * (0.3 - inno_ah)\n            lp += ev_t[m] * math.log(1.2) + ev_f[m] * math.log(0.76 / 0.80)\n            logp[m] = lp\n        mx = max(logp.values())\n        ps = {m: math.exp(v - mx) for m, v in logp.items()}\n        s = sum(ps.values())\n        ps = {m: v/s for m, v in ps.items()}\n        print(f\"use_nh={str(use_nh):5s} dsl_frame={dsl_frame:.3f} -> \" +\n              \", \".join(f\"{m}:{ps[m]:.4f}\" for m in [\"e16\", \"e30\", \"e34\", \"e04\"]))\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker_d7.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/tracker_d7.py","time":{"start":1794722654175,"end":1794722654178}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1ddce67dc001MFAXCrvChiEQGI","sessionID":"ses_e2247747bffeK82TWTGuBjTUDR","messageID":"msg_1ddce0c01001g4DBj2WX8zgMcO"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794722710285,"sessionID":"ses_e2247747bffeK82TWTGuBjTUDR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"D3sn1Yq8JeGgfXgU","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import math\n\ncands = {\"e16\": \"A\", \"e30\": \"A\", \"e34\": \"C\", \"e04\": \"B\"}\nnh = {\"e16\": 5, \"e30\": 11, \"e34\": 3, \"e04\": 8}\nah = {\"e16\": 2, \"e30\": 0,  \"e34\": 0, \"e04\": 0}\n# Day 7 interviews: e16 got 2T, 2F -> total 3T, 9F; e30 got 0T, 2F -> total 1T, 7F\nev_t = {\"e16\": 3, \"e30\": 1, \"e34\": 0, \"e04\": 0}\nev_f = {\"e16\": 9, \"e30\": 7, \"e34\": 0, \"e04\": 0}\nn_days = 6\n\nfor use_nh in [True, False]:\n    for dsl_frame in [0.0, 1.0/39.0]:\n        logp = {}\n        for m, var in cands.items():\n            lp = math.log(0.95 if var == \"A\" else 0.025)\n            inno_ah = 0.1 + 1.0/38.0 + dsl_frame\n            if use_nh:\n                lp += nh[m] * math.log(0.7 / 0.9) - n_days * (0.7 - 0.9)\n            lp += ah[m] * math.log(0.3 / inno_ah) - n_days * (0.3 - inno_ah)\n            lp += ev_t[m] * math.log(1.2) + ev_f[m] * math.log(0.76 / 0.80)\n            logp[m] = lp\n        mx = max(logp.values())\n        ps = {m: math.exp(v - mx) for m, v in logp.items()}\n        s = sum(ps.values())\n        ps = {m: v/s for m, v in ps.items()}\n        # Compare EV of accusing now (true_V ≈ 0.6175) vs waiting 1 day (true_V ≈ 0.585, catching mole w/ ~0.99)\n        p16 = ps[\"e16\"]\n        ev_now = p16 * 0.6175 - (1 - p16) * 1.0\n        print(f\"use_nh={str(use_nh):5s} dsl_frame={dsl_frame:.3f} -> P(e16)={p16:.4f}, P(e30)={ps['e30']:.4f} | EV_accuse_now={ev_now:.4f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/check_accuse_d7.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/check_accuse_d7.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/check_accuse_d7.py","time":{"start":1794722710278,"end":1794722710284}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1ddcf4301001jLYwMbBR3nT446","sessionID":"ses_e2247747bffeK82TWTGuBjTUDR","messageID":"msg_1ddcf049d001dOc5aj2RuaSzV4"}}
